title: Electronic engine controls — 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS)
introduction:
I begin with the engine's jobs: take in air, meter fuel, control combustion and turn piston movement into crankshaft rotation. That is a useful map when the electronic-control terminology starts looking like alphabet soup.

This page points you to the operating description for the engine controls. The explanation itself is in the referenced manual; this page contains no component descriptions, measurements or diagnostic sequence. Check the engine identification when choosing the applicable material.

edits.text: Begin with the operating description to understand the system before studying its individual components.
edits.why: The system's overall purpose helps make individual component descriptions easier to interpret.

edits.text: Where to read about system operation
Read the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) Manual, Section 1, Description and Operation, for the system operating description.
edits.why: The referral identifies the next reading destination; it does not supply a diagnostic result or authorize a component replacement.
